dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal midline display sharp pixel intensity transitions from low-intensity black backgrounds to high-intensity light grey perimeters. The internal regions of these rings exhibit a gradient shift back to darker values, creating well-defined, thin-walled geometric boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of light-intensity pixel clusters is observed along the mid-body and cervical regions. Pixel concentration is primarily localized in the narrow, curvilinear outlines of the annuli rather than solid blocks, with the highest density occurring in the central dorsal region where patterns overlap.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest 'O' shaped structures on the upper dorsal surface form an obtuse triangle. Connecting these with two adjacent lateral 'C' shaped structures creates an irregular pentagonal geometric relationship that defines the primary identification cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, high-contrast collar-like band of light-intensity markings is present around the neck. A unique vertical alignment of three small, isolated high-intensity spots is visible on the posterior flank near the base of the hind flipper.
